CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_user_role()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
  SELECT role::text
  FROM public.user
  WHERE id = auth.uid()
  LIMIT 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  _role public.user_role := 'rider';
  _user_id uuid := new.id;
  _lang text := 'en';
  _tz text := 'UTC';
  _meta jsonb := coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb);
  _name text;
  _avatar text;
  _company_name text;
begin
  -- Only trust server-assigned role.
  if (_meta ? 'server_assigned_role') then
    begin
      _role := (_meta->>'server_assigned_role')::public.user_role;
    exception
      when others then
        _role := 'rider';
    end;
  end if;

  _name := coalesce(nullif(_meta->>'full_name', ''), new.email, '');
  _avatar := coalesce(
    nullif(_meta->>'avatar_url', ''),
    nullif(_meta->>'avatarUrl', ''),
    nullif(_meta->>'avatarurl', '')
  );

  insert into public."user" (
    id,
    email,
    name,
    phone,
    organization,
    avatar_url,
    role,
    created_at,
    updated_at
  )
  values (
    new.id,
    new.email,
    _name,
    nullif(_meta->>'phone', ''),
    null,
    _avatar,
    _role,
    now(),
    now()
  )
  on conflict (id) do update
  set email = excluded.email,
      name = case
        when coalesce(public."user".name, '') = '' then excluded.name
        else public."user".name
      end,
      phone = coalesce(public."user".phone, excluded.phone),
      avatar_url = coalesce(public."user".avatar_url, excluded.avatar_url),
      role = public."user".role,
      updated_at = now();

  if _role = 'rider' then
    insert into public.rider (
      user_id,
      created_at,
      phone,
      city,
      country
    )
    values (
      _user_id,
      now(),
      nullif(_meta->>'phone', ''),
      nullif(_meta->>'city', ''),
      nullif(_meta->>'country', '')
    )
    on conflict (user_id) do update
    set phone = coalesce(public.rider.phone, excluded.phone),
        city = coalesce(public.rider.city, excluded.city),
        country = coalesce(public.rider.country, excluded.country);
  end if;

  if _role = 'advertiser' then
    _lang := coalesce(nullif(_meta->>'language', ''), 'en');
    _tz := coalesce(nullif(_meta->>'timezone', ''), 'UTC');
    _company_name := nullif(_meta->>'companyName', '');

    insert into public.advertiser (
      user_id,
      company_name,
      language,
      timezone,
      created_at
    )
    values (
      _user_id,
      _company_name,
      _lang,
      _tz,
      now()
    )
    on conflict (user_id) do update
    set company_name = coalesce(public.advertiser.company_name, excluded.company_name),
        language = coalesce(public.advertiser.language, excluded.language),
        timezone = coalesce(public.advertiser.timezone, excluded.timezone);
  end if;

  return null;
exception
  when others then
    raise log 'handle_new_user failed for auth.users.id=% email=% error=%',
      new.id, new.email, sqlerrm;
    raise;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.held_ride_recovery_has_capability(p_actor uuid, p_capability text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.admin_users a JOIN (VALUES
  ('super_admin','rides.settlement.recovery.request'),
  ('super_admin','rides.settlement.recovery.review'),
  ('operations_manager','rides.settlement.recovery.review'),
  ('finance_operator','rides.settlement.recovery.review'),
  ('engineering_operations','rides.settlement.recovery.request'),
  ('admin','rides.settlement.recovery.review')
 ) grants(role,capability) ON lower(btrim(a.role))=grants.role
 WHERE a.user_id=p_actor AND grants.capability=p_capability);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.held_ride_recovery_operator(p_capability text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE actor uuid:=auth.uid();
BEGIN
 IF actor IS NULL OR coalesce(nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims',true),'')::jsonb->>'aal','')<>'aal2' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501',MESSAGE='authenticated MFA operator required';END IF;
 -- Reuse Admin's trusted dashboard session, 12-hour maximum and one-second
 -- sign-in binding; require MFA even if the general policy permits AAL1.
 PERFORM 1 FROM public.admin_users a
 JOIN public.admin_dashboard_sessions ds ON ds.admin_user_id=a.id AND ds.auth_user_id=a.user_id
 JOIN auth.users au ON au.id=a.user_id
 WHERE a.user_id=actor AND public.held_ride_recovery_has_capability(actor,p_capability)
  AND ds.session_expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND ds.session_started_at>clock_timestamp()-interval '12 hours'
  AND abs(extract(epoch FROM ds.auth_last_sign_in_at-au.last_sign_in_at))<=1
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.account_deletion_write_guard g WHERE g.user_id=actor AND g.restricted)
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.account_deletion_jobs j WHERE j.user_id=actor)
 FOR SHARE OF a,ds;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501',MESSAGE='current authorized recovery operator session required';END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.ride_session s JOIN public.rider r ON r.id=s.rider_id WHERE s.id='fb5df08c-06ad-4b25-ac0d-81419226e3a4' AND r.user_id=actor) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'operator must be independent of rider';END IF;
 RETURN actor;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_dashboard_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.admin_users au
    WHERE au.user_id = auth.uid()
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_super_admin(check_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  user_role text;
BEGIN
  -- Get the user's role from admin_users without triggering RLS recursion
  SELECT role INTO user_role 
  FROM admin_users 
  WHERE user_id = check_user_id;
  
  RETURN user_role = 'super_admin';
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.shop_operating_status(p_actor uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ BEGIN
 PERFORM shop_authorize(p_actor,'read');
 RETURN (SELECT to_jsonb(s)||jsonb_build_object('canManage',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM admin_users WHERE user_id=p_actor AND role IN ('super_admin','security_admin')),
 'evidence',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e) ORDER BY criterion) FROM shop_readiness_evidence e),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM shop_release_control s WHERE singleton);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.shop_require_controller(p_actor uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ BEGIN
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM admin_users WHERE user_id=p_actor AND role IN ('super_admin','security_admin')) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Security administrator required' USING ERRCODE='42501';
 END IF;
END $function$
